pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which sentence means "Thank you!"? (1 mark)
   A. 老师好!
   B. 你呢?
   C. 谢谢!
   D. 我叫小明。

2. Which sentence means "For breakfast I eat bǐng."? (1 mark)
   A. 我喜欢吃香蕉。
   B. 这是香蕉。
   C. 我喝茶。
   D. 我早饭吃饼。

3. Fill the blank: 我早饭____饼。 (For breakfast I eat bǐng.) (1 mark)
   A. 喝
   B. 去
   C. 吃
   D. 是

4. How many rooms are named in 我家有客厅、卧室和厨房? (1 mark)
   A. Five
   B. Three
   C. Two
   D. Four

5. Which Chinese word means "water"? (1 mark)
   A. 喜欢 xǐhuan
   B. 水 shuǐ
   C. 晚饭 wǎnfàn
   D. 牛肉 niúròu

6. What does 放 (fàng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Is at, is in
   B. Beside
   C. To put
   D. Things

7. Which two words are said with a tone followed by a light syllable? (1 mark)
   A. bàba and gēge
   B. dà and xiǎo
   C. nǐ and hǎo
   D. wǒ and nǐ

8. What does 也 (yě) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Cloud
   B. Small
   C. Also
   D. It rains

9. What does 星期一到星期五,我上学 mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Sunday, I rest at home
   B. Monday is a holiday
   C. From Monday to Friday, I go to school
   D. I go to school on Saturday

10. What does 今天天气很好 mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today is Sunday
   B. The weather is very good today
   C. It rains today
   D. I am going to school

11. Which Chinese word means "left side"? (1 mark)
   A. 左边 zuǒbian
   B. 门 mén
   C. 客厅 kètīng
   D. 东西 dōngxi

12. In the syllable mā, which part is the final? (1 mark)
   A. ā only with a dot
   B. a
   C. ma
   D. m

13. Which sentence means "I like to drink tea."? (1 mark)
   A. 我喝茶。
   B. 我喜欢喝茶。
   C. 这是香蕉。
   D. 我早饭吃饼。

14. Which two words share the final -ang? (1 mark)
   A. 好 hǎo and 老 lǎo
   B. 小 xiǎo and 早 zǎo
   C. 房 fáng and 旁 páng
   D. 门 mén and 手 shǒu

15. What does 不 (bù) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Not
   B. Small
   C. Very
   D. Weather

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Happy birthday to you!" and "When is your birthday?" (4 marks)

17. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The television is in the living room." (2 marks)

18. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 星期天 and 早上好. (2 marks)

19. Put these pinyin words in alphabetical order: mǐfàn, bǐng, chá. (3 marks)

20. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 送 and 床. (2 marks)

21. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — 谢谢!
   谢谢! (xièxie!) means "Thank you!".

2. D — 我早饭吃饼。
   我早饭吃饼。 (wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng.) means "For breakfast I eat bǐng.".

3. C — 吃
   饼 is food, so 吃.

4. B — Three
   The rooms are the living room, the bedroom and the kitchen.

5. B — 水 shuǐ
   水 (shuǐ) means water.

6. C — To put
   放 (fàng) means to put.

7. A — bàba and gēge
   The second syllable of bàba and gēge is neutral.

8. C — Also
   也 (yě) means also.

9. C — From Monday to Friday, I go to school
   到 is to, and 上学 is go to school.

10. B — The weather is very good today
   天气 is weather and 很好 is very good.

11. A — 左边 zuǒbian
   左边 (zuǒbian) means left side.

12. B — a
   m is the initial and a is the final, with the first tone.

13. B — 我喜欢喝茶。
   我喜欢喝茶。 (wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.) means "I like to drink tea.".

14. C — 房 fáng and 旁 páng
   fáng and páng both end in ang.

15. A — Not
   不 (bù) means not.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè! 你生日是几月几号? nǐ shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: 电视在客厅。 diànshì zài kètīng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: 星期天: xīngqītiān, Sunday. 早上好: zǎoshang hǎo, good morning.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: bǐng, chá, mǐfàn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct position.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: 送: sòng, to give (a gift). 床: chuáng, bed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: The television is on the table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.
